title: Placement Test
subtitle: Find your current English level (A1-C2).
about: This test estimates your English level and helps us recommend the right group for you. It is a placement recommendation, not an official certificate.

rules.duration: Takes about 20-30 minutes. You can pause and continue within 24 hours.
rules.sections: Sections: grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, one writing task, and a speaking assessment with a teacher.
rules.adaptive: Questions adapt to your answers - the test gets easier or harder to find your level quickly.
rules.rules: Answer honestly and without help. You cannot see correct answers during the test, and you cannot retake while an attempt is running.
rules.writing: The writing task is reviewed by a teacher using a rubric.
rules.speaking: The speaking part is a short live assessment with a teacher - the test shows you the topics in advance.
